@omc-reference @writer-memory @gsd-explore @gsd-code-review-fix @gsd-audit-milestone @gsd-debug @systematic-debugging Perform a comprehensive production-readiness audit and fix of the entire codebase. This is a critical pre-launch review. The application must be fully functional and deployable by tomorrow.

Phase 1: Full Codebase Audit
Scan every file in the project. Catalog all issues by severity: critical bugs, runtime errors, type safety violations, silent failures, unhandled edge cases, memory leaks, performance bottlenecks, security vulnerabilities, accessibility violations, and dead code. Do not skip any file or directory.

Phase 2: Code Quality Fixes
Eliminate all "as any" type casts and replace with proper type guards. Remove all eslint and typescript warnings. Fix all console.error and console.log statements that should be proper user-facing error handling. Ensure consistent error handling patterns across the entire application. Remove dead code, unused imports, and unreachable branches. Enforce consistent naming conventions and code style throughout.

Phase 3: Functional Verification
Trace every user-facing feature end to end. Verify all import trade flows for every supported platform work correctly with real data formats. Verify all calculations, aggregations, and data transformations produce correct results. Verify all forms validate input properly and display clear error messages. Verify navigation, routing, and state management work without errors. Verify all API calls handle success, loading, and error states properly.

Phase 4: Production Hardening
Add proper error boundaries around all major feature sections. Ensure all async operations have loading states, error states, and timeout handling. Add input sanitization on all user-facing inputs. Verify environment variables and configuration are properly managed. Ensure no sensitive data is exposed in client-side code. Add proper loading skeletons and feedback for all async operations. Verify responsive design works across mobile, tablet, and desktop.

Phase 5: Build and Deploy Verification
Run the full build with zero errors and zero warnings. Verify the production bundle has no issues. Test that the deployed application loads and functions correctly.

Execute all phases systematically. Fix every issue you find. Do not leave any known issues unresolved. Report what you fixed and what the current state is after all fixes are complete.
